# ID42 Studio
> Applied AI studio. We design AI agents, automations and integrations that take over the repetitive work of a company's operation — connected to the CRM, ERP and WhatsApp it already runs.

## Pages
- [Português](https://id42studio.github.io/): default locale
- [English](https://id42studio.github.io/en/): English version

## What we do
- Sales agents (WhatsApp, qualification, follow-up, CRM logging)
- Workflow automation (CRM, ERP, email, spreadsheets, APIs)
- Knowledge copilots (RAG over internal documents)
- Systems integration (Odoo/ERP, CRM, support platforms)
- Digital products (MVPs and micro-SaaS)

## Products in production
- [VBSell](https://vbsell.com): WhatsApp AI sales agents
- [BuilderMonitor](https://buildermonitor.cloud.escodoo.com): operational and executive radar for construction sites
- [Deepze](https://deepze.ai): private enterprise AI with RAG on customer infrastructure
